title: Mittag-Leffler for Hom from a constant perfect reduction model
statement: Let X be a scheme, A a commutative Noetherian ring and J an ideal. Let U be affine and weakly contractible on the coefficient-sized pro-etale slice, in the precise sense of [def-sfb-adic-residue-lift-comparisons]. Let P be a bounded finite-projective A-cochain complex, T=(B_X tensor_A P)|U and M in D(B_X|U) be locally complete. Suppose R_n(T) and R_n(M) are isomorphic for every n, without compatible choices. Then the actual Hom tower G_n=Hom(R_n(T),R_n(M)), with the normalized conjugated scalar-extension transitions of [def-sfb-adic-residue-lift-comparisons], is Mittag-Leffler.

source.place: Tags 09C5 and 09C6, dual-perfect tensor calculation and exact sections on each affine weakly contractible covering object.

proof.text: For a triple t >= m >= n choose a single isomorphism e_t:R_t(T)≅R_t(M). Define e_m and e_n by reduction using adicResidueHomTower. The prescribed successor maps preserve identity and composition, by cancellation of the normalized reassociation and its inverse. Induction gives these identities for arbitrary transition arrows. Thus reduction of e_t and its inverse is an isomorphism at every lower level. The maps x↦x≫e_i.inv are bijective at the three levels and intertwine the arrow m→n and the composite t→n. This is a finite-triple range comparison with the endomorphism tower of T. No compatibility of the original markings and no completeness is used.

Apply the quotient Hom/cohomology comparison with Q=P. Its successor compatibility extends to all arrows by induction, giving a finite-triple comparison of the endomorphism tower of T with constant-module sections of H^0 of the actual quotients of moduleHomComplex(P,P).

The degree-one term of moduleHomComplex(P,P) is finite. Restriction to the finite support interval [c,d] embeds its cochains into the finite product Hom_A(P^i,P^(i+1)); outside that interval the source is zero. Over the Noetherian ring these Hom modules are finite, and an injective linear map into a finite module has finite source. Apply the Artin-Rees short-complex cohomology theorem to (moduleHomComplex P P).sc 0. Exact constant-module sections preserve the stabilized images.

Transfer Mittag-Leffler first to the endomorphism tower and then to the desired Hom tower using the two finite-triple comparisons. This completes the original statement without its completeness or affine hypotheses, whose binders are retained verbatim.

proof_origin.place: Tags 09C5 and 09C6: finite-triple markings and fixed perfect Hom calculation, followed by Artin-Rees. The Hom tower is compared directly to the fixed model; no complete internal-Hom object is needed.

theorem adicResidueHomTower_mittagLeffler
    (X : Scheme.{u}) {A : Type (max v (u + 1))} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (J : Ideal A) (U : coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X)
    (_hAffine : IsAffine
      ((AsSmall.down : coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X ⥤ X.ProEt).obj U).left)
    (_hU : AdicResidueSliceWeaklyContractible.{u, v} X U)
    (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A) ℤ) (c d : ℤ)
    (_hc : P.IsStrictlyGE c) (_hd : P.IsStrictlyLE d)
    (_hP : ∀ q : ℤ, Module.Finite A (P.X q) ∧ Module.Projective A (P.X q))
    (M : AdicResidueLocalDerived.{u, v} X J U)
    (_hM : CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.IsComplete
      (adicResidueLocalProjection.{u, v} X J U 0) M)
    (_hfinite : ∀ n : ℕ, Nonempty
      ((adicResidueLocalReduction.{u, v} X J U n).obj
        ((adicResidueRestriction
      (CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.completed (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X)
        A J) U).obj (adicResidueConstantPerfect.{u, v} X J P)) ≅
        (adicResidueLocalReduction.{u, v} X J U n).obj M)) :
    (adicResidueHomTower.{u, v} X J U
      ((adicResidueRestriction
      (CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.completed (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X)
        A J) U).obj (adicResidueConstantPerfect.{u, v} X J P)) M).IsMittagLeffler
